description: An invented specialty coffee roaster, used here as a worked example. Around sixty people: one roastery, about a hundred and eighty wholesale cafes, a webshop with a subscription, and a bar at the front of the building. No real company, and none of the numbers are anybody's.

actors.name: Bookkeeper
actors.notes: Part time, three days a week

actors.name: Roast Control Software
actors.notes: Runs on the roaster's own PC

actors.name: Green Coffee Importer
actors.notes: Two of them, one portal each

artifacts.name: Importer offer sheet
artifacts.notes: A spreadsheet per importer, laid out differently each season

artifacts.name: Green coffee sample
artifacts.notes: 200g in a bag, with a lot number on it

artifacts.name: Wholesale order message
artifacts.notes: Email, WhatsApp, and about a fifth by phone

artifacts.name: Subscription feedback
artifacts.notes: Free text from the monthly survey

artifacts.name: Timesheet
artifacts.notes: Filled in by staff, outside anything mapped here

artifacts.name: House taste standard
artifacts.notes: What the coffee is supposed to taste like. Two people know it and it is written down nowhere

artifacts.name: Roast profile
artifacts.notes: Curve and drop temperature per coffee

artifacts.name: Batch label
artifacts.notes: Carries the roast date and the lot

artifacts.name: Traceability record
artifacts.notes: Goes to the certifier and, on request, the customer

functions.name: Request offer samples
functions.description: Read what the importers are offering and ask for samples of anything worth cupping.
functions.notes: Each importer has its own portal and its own spreadsheet layout.

functions.name: Roast offer samples
functions.description: Roast each sample on the fixed sample profile so the cupping compares like with like.
functions.notes: The sample roaster is a standalone machine with no logging at all.

functions.name: Cup and score samples
functions.description: Taste the sample roasts blind, score them, and decide which lots are worth a contract.
functions.notes: The thing being judged is a taste. There is no version of this a machine does.

functions.name: Forecast green demand
functions.description: Work out how much of each origin will be needed over the next two quarters.

functions.name: Negotiate green contracts
functions.description: Agree price, volume and shipment window with importers and direct-trade farms.

functions.name: Book green coffee in
functions.description: Check a delivery against the contract and book the sacks into the warehouse.

functions.name: Reconcile green stock
functions.description: Compare what the ERP thinks is in the warehouse against what is actually on the pallets.

functions.name: Build the weekly roast plan
functions.description: Turn next week's orders into batches, in an order the roasters can actually run.
functions.notes: Getting this wrong means a cafe opens on Monday with no coffee.

functions.name: Run roast batches
functions.description: Roast each batch on its profile and record what the machine did.
functions.notes: The roast software drives the machine but exports nothing without a person clicking.

functions.name: Adjust roast profiles
functions.description: Change the curve when a new crop lands and the old profile stops tasting right.

functions.name: Print and apply batch labels
functions.description: Generate the label for each batch: coffee, roast date, lot, weight.

functions.name: Pack roasted coffee
functions.description: Weigh, fill, seal and label retail bags from bulk.

functions.name: Review roast yield
functions.description: Compare green in against roasted out per batch and chase anything outside the band.

functions.name: Cup production batches
functions.description: Taste a sample from every production day against the reference for that coffee.
functions.notes: Comparison against a standard, not free judgement. The standard is the problem: it is in two people's heads.

functions.name: Measure moisture and density
functions.description: Run the intake measurements on every arriving lot and file the numbers.

functions.name: Triage quality complaints
functions.description: Decide whether a complaint is a one-off, a batch problem, or a recall.

functions.name: Trace a batch back to a lot
functions.description: Follow a bag on a shelf back through the batch record to the green contract.
functions.notes: Every fact needed is already in a database. It is still done by hand, and the certifier asks twice a year.

functions.name: Take wholesale orders
functions.description: Read the orders that arrive by email, message and phone, and get them into the order book.
functions.notes: About a fifth still arrive as a phone call, which is why this is not one job but two.

functions.name: Generate standing orders
functions.description: Raise the recurring orders for accounts on a fixed weekly volume.

functions.name: Onboard a wholesale cafe
functions.description: Set up a new cafe: record, pricing, first delivery, and an install if they need a grinder.

functions.name: Monthly account check-in
functions.description: Call the accounts on the list and find out how they are getting on.

functions.name: Reissue the wholesale price list
functions.description: Rebuild the price list when green costs or the cost model move.

functions.name: Spot accounts that went quiet
functions.description: Find the cafes whose ordering has dropped off before somebody notices at year end.

functions.name: Run barista training
functions.description: Spend a morning on a cafe's bar getting their staff and their grinder in shape.

functions.name: Charge and schedule renewals
functions.description: Take payment for the month's subscriptions and raise the orders behind them.
functions.notes: Charging people money. Automated, and still watched every month.

functions.name: Chase failed payments
functions.description: Retry a failed card, tell the customer, and cancel after the third try.
functions.notes: The rule is written on a card next to the desk. Nobody has ever put it in software.

functions.name: Pick and pack webshop orders
functions.description: Pull the bags for each order, box them, and put the label on.
functions.notes: The largest single block of hours in the company, and none of it is a software problem.

functions.name: Write product pages
functions.description: Write up a new coffee for the shop: origin, tasting notes, the story.

functions.name: Build the dispatch roster
functions.description: Work out who gets which coffee in which grind on the next dispatch date.

functions.name: Answer webshop customers
functions.description: Reply to the shop inbox: where is my order, change my grind, pause me for a month.

functions.name: Choose next month's coffees
functions.description: Read the feedback and pick what goes out to subscribers next month.

functions.name: Book parcel collections
functions.description: Hand the day's parcels to the carrier and get the manifest back.

functions.name: Plan the delivery round
functions.description: Put the day's wholesale drops into an order the vans can do before the cafes get busy.

functions.name: Drive the wholesale round
functions.description: Load the van, do the drops, get the deliveries signed for.

functions.name: File carrier damage claims
functions.description: Put in a claim when a parcel arrives crushed, and chase it.

functions.name: Reorder packaging
functions.description: Order bags, boxes and valves before the shelf runs out mid-week.

functions.name: Issue wholesale invoices
functions.description: Turn signed deliveries into invoices at the right price for each account.

functions.name: Match payments to invoices
functions.description: Work out which invoice each incoming payment is for, including the part payments.

functions.name: Chase overdue invoices
functions.description: Work the aged debt list and decide who gets a reminder and who gets a phone call.
functions.notes: A badly aimed reminder costs an account, so somebody looks at every one.

functions.name: Enter supplier invoices
functions.description: Get supplier PDFs into the ledger against the right cost centre.

functions.name: Pay suppliers
functions.description: Release the fortnightly payment run to the bank.
functions.notes: Every fact is machine-readable and it will still never run unattended.

functions.name: Close the month
functions.description: Reconcile, accrue, and produce the management accounts.

functions.name: Update the cost per kilo
functions.description: Rebuild what each coffee actually costs once yield, freight and labour are in.

functions.name: File the VAT return
functions.description: Prepare and submit the quarterly return.

functions.name: Run payroll
functions.description: Turn timesheets and contracts into the monthly payroll file.

functions.name: Build the shift rota
functions.description: Cover the roastery, the packing bench and the bar for the coming fortnight.
functions.notes: Rewritten twice a week on average, because somebody is always ill.

functions.name: Screen applications
functions.description: Read applications for packing and barista roles and put a shortlist together.

functions.name: Onboard a new starter
functions.description: Contract, payroll, kit, keys, and the first week's training.
functions.notes: Nobody owns this. It gets done by whoever hired the person, differently each time.

functions.name: Schedule equipment servicing
functions.description: Book the six-month service on every grinder and machine out on loan.

functions.name: Handle maintenance requests
functions.description: Deal with whatever has broken in the roastery this week.
